visualCharacteristics.variantDescriptor: Borderless cards: image on top, small uppercase bold title, body, uppercase arrow link; 3 per row.
visualCharacteristics.sectionStylingNotes: Three equal cards in a row: landscape image on top, small bold uppercase title, body text, uppercase blue arrow link "LEARN MORE". No borders or card backgrounds.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Row of borderless cards with image on top, title, body and link

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 image; cell 2 rich text (bold title paragraph, body paragraph, link paragraph)
contentPattern.description: 3 cards (Job Applicants/HCPs/Patients; Clinical Investigators and Staff; Global Privacy Notices) each with image, title, text and Learn More link to a detail page

usage: Use for a set of navigational teasers (typically 3 per row) linking to detail pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for image-top teaser cards without borders or card backgrounds. Use the base cards block for bordered cards.
